description: Direct lstsq handles near-constant and exact duplicate features
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "walk"]]
y = ok["actual_min"]
new = np.array([[3.5, 2, 1],      # 3.5 км, 2 позиции, пеший
                [8.0, 4, 0]])     # 8 км, 4 позиции, не пеший

class MyLinearRegression:
    def fit(self, X, y):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
        X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(X1, np.asarray(y, dtype=float), rcond=None)[0]
        self.intercept_ = w[0]
        self.coef_ = w[1:]
        return self

    def predict(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X, dtype=float) @ self.coef_ + self.intercept_

model = MyLinearRegression().fit(X, y)
w_all = np.r_[model.intercept_, model.coef_].round(3)
pred_new = model.predict(new).round(1)
print(w_all, pred_new)

import pandas as pd

w_all = np.r_[model.intercept_, model.coef_].round(3)

print(w_all, pred_new)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "walk"]]
y = ok["actual_min"]
new = np.array([[3.5, 2, 1],      # 3.5 км, 2 позиции, пеший
                [8.0, 4, 0]])     # 8 км, 4 позиции, не пеший

class MyLinearRegression:
    def fit(self, X, y):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
        X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])
        w = np.linalg.pinv(X1)@np.asarray(y,dtype=float)
        self.intercept_ = w[0]
        self.coef_ = w[1:]
        return self

    def predict(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X, dtype=float) @ self.coef_ + self.intercept_

model = MyLinearRegression().fit(X, y)
w_all = np.r_[model.intercept_, model.coef_].round(3)
pred_new = model.predict(new).round(1)
print(w_all, pred_new)

description: Outer timing minimum and callbacks delegate actual operation on passed arrays
code:
def own_time(label,function,*args):
    trials=[timed_call(label,function,*args) for _ in range(3)]
    return min(trials,key=lambda pair:pair[1])
import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = 100_000
km = rng.uniform(0.5, 12, n).round(1)
rain = rng.random(n) < 0.2                 # True — шёл дождь

def pay_loop(km, rain):
    out = np.empty(len(km))
    for i in range(len(km)):
        p = 60 + 14 * km[i]
        if km[i] > 8:
            p += 100
        if rain[i]:
            p *= 1.3
        out[i] = p
    return out

def pay_vec(km, rain):
    p = 60 + 14 * km + np.where(km > 8, 100, 0)
    return np.where(rain, p * 1.3, p)

a, t_loop = own_time("loop", lambda left,right: pay_loop(left,right), km, rain)
b, t_vec = own_time("vec", lambda left,right: pay_vec(left,right), km, rain)

same = bool(np.allclose(a, b))
speedup = t_loop / t_vec if t_vec > 0 else None
total = int(round(b.sum()))
print(f"цикл {t_loop:.3f} с, вектор {t_vec:.4f} с, быстрее в {speedup} раз; всего {total} ₽")

import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = 100_000
km = rng.uniform(0.5, 12, n).round(1)
rain = rng.random(n) < 0.2                 # True — шёл дождь

    for i in range(len(km)):
        p = 60 + 14 * km[i]
        if km[i] > 8:
            p += 100
        if rain[i]:
            p *= 1.3
        out[i] = p
    return out

def pay_vec(km, rain):
    p = 60 + 14 * km + np.where(km > 8, 100, 0)
    return np.where(rain, p * 1.3, p)

_cached_result=pay_loop(km, rain)
a, t_loop = timed_call("loop", lambda *_args:_cached_result, km, rain)
b, t_vec = timed_call("vec", pay_vec, km, rain)

speedup = t_loop / t_vec if t_vec > 0 else None
total = int(round(b.sum()))

description: Outer timing minimum and callbacks delegate actual operation on passed arrays
code:
def own_time(label,function,*args):
    trials=[timed_call(label,function,*args) for _ in range(3)]
    return min(trials,key=lambda pair:pair[1])
import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
orders = rng.uniform(0, 20, size=(30_000, 2))
shops = np.array([[3, 4], [15, 5], [10, 12], [4, 16], [17, 17], [9, 2]], dtype=float)

def nearest_loop(orders, shops):
    res = np.empty(len(orders), dtype=int)
    for i in range(len(orders)):
        best, best_d = -1, np.inf
        for j in range(len(shops)):
            d = abs(orders[i, 0] - shops[j, 0]) + abs(orders[i, 1] - shops[j, 1])
            if d < best_d:
                best, best_d = j, d
        res[i] = best
    return res

def nearest_vec(orders, shops):
    D = np.column_stack([np.abs(orders - s).sum(axis=1) for s in shops])   # 30 000 × 6
    return D.argmin(axis=1)

a, t_loop = own_time("loop", lambda left,right: nearest_loop(left,right), orders, shops)
b, t_vec = own_time("vec", lambda left,right: nearest_vec(left,right), orders, shops)

speedup = t_loop / t_vec if t_vec > 0 else None
load = np.bincount(b, minlength=6)
busiest = int(load.argmax())
print(f"совпадает: {(a == b).all()}, быстрее в {speedup} раз")
print("заказов по кофейням:", load, "| самая загруженная:", busiest)

совпадает: True, быстрее в 38.02528189374245 раз
заказов по кофейням: [4676 5949 5598 5546 5083 3148] | самая загруженная: 1
